name: Sandwich Attack (MEV)
summary: Attacker front-runs a pending user swap, then back-runs it. Detector observes the front/back pattern on the same block and flags MEV extraction.
expectedOutcome: Three PendingTxEvents in order (front, victim, back). Detector emits MEV_SANDWICH verdict. Defense is advisory (alert only) — sandwiching is legal-but-hostile, so no on-chain pause.

steps.text: Innocent user queues swap. Attacker observes mempool.
Front-run in, victim tx, back-run out — all same block
PreemptiveAlertEvent@1 — pattern MEV_SANDWICH. Advisory, no pause.
